# DD CPQ skills for Claude

The DD CPQ skills and the DD CPQ connector, as a Claude plugin marketplace.

**Do not edit this repo.** It is published automatically from the DD CPQ
engine repo on every merge; changes made here are overwritten.

## Install

- **Cowork:** Customize → Plugins → Add marketplace → Add from a repository →
  `deepdiveitai-blip/deepdive-cpq-skills`, then install **DD CPQ** (testers:
  **DD CPQ (read-only)**).
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add deepdiveitai-blip/deepdive-cpq-skills`,
  then `/plugin install dd-cpq@deepdive-cpq`.

The connector signs you in to Salesforce as yourself; it only works for
users of an org DD CPQ allows.
